screened.motion: This house believes engineering teams should route agent work to the cheapest model that passes their tests, rather than standardise on one frontier model.
screened.why: Each argues against the side they were given, yet both end up recommending the same hybrid: send routine, well-tested work to cheap models and keep one frontier model as the default for ambiguous work, citing the same worries about weak tests and lost prompt-cache savings.

screened.motion: This house believes coordinated disclosure no longer works once AI lets several teams find the same bug.
screened.why: Both say coordination should continue but disclosure windows have to shrink sharply, and they differ mostly in how they frame it ("the 90-day embargo is dead" versus "coordination isn't failing").

why: Neither the pick nor the backup split the agents in their private openings.
